review_scope: Complete contact sheets 01, 02, 03 and 19 at original image resolution, with native RGB frames 0016, 0088 and 0239 cross-checked; all other sheets unreviewed

notes.S_RIGHT_30: One right-hand 30 km/h sign repeated across 19 frames, not 19 separate objects; readable 30 face and tag-8 footprint match.
notes.S_EARLY_LEFT_BACK: One left sign reverse face/pole, exiting left frame edge by 0016; original RGB has a red-rimmed round physical sign.
notes.S_LATER_LEFT_BACK: Another left sign reverse face/pole by 0088-0089; world position is about 29.8 m from the early left sign.
notes.uncertain: Small selected crops are not sufficiently readable or their temporal identity is not established; counted against the reviewed quality numerator.

policy: Unlisted components are unreviewed, not valid. Back faces count as physical sign-class objects, not as readable speed-limit content. Geometry only separates candidate objects and never substitutes for RGB review.
